short_description: reg_f3d with its defaults: cubic B-spline with control points every 5 voxels, NMI with 64 bins, bending energy 0.001, first-order penalty 0.01, no Jacobian penalty, 3 levels; NiftyReg v2.0.0 built from the authors' repository on first use (cmake and a C++ compiler needed). description: reg_f3d with its defaults: cubic B-spline with control points every 5 voxels, NMI with 64 bins, bending energy 0.001, first-order penalty 0.01, no Jacobian penalty, 3 levels; NiftyReg v2.0.0 built from the authors' repository on first use (cmake and a C++ compiler needed). The ImagingBenchmarks baseline niftyreg. CPU. The pair must be aligned (rigidly for one patient, by an affine transform between two subjects): only the deformable stage runs. Masks are ignored by this baseline. Output: the displacement field on the fixed grid, in mm along the world axes (ITK, LPS).
